name: Travel
overview: Scripture reveals that travel is under the sovereign care and guidance of the LORD, who goes before His people and fights for them as He did for Israel in Egypt. Believers are called to be strong and courageous, faithfully obeying God's Word to prosper wherever they journey. The steps of the righteous are ordered by God, who delights in their way and provides angelic protection along all their paths. His Word serves as a lamp to illuminate the way, and our help comes from Him, assuring safety and direction in every journey.
